title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Attention All Fernbrook Library Users

The self-service machines will be out of use on 14 August from 7:00 P.M. onward. A new version of the catalogue software will be installed at that time, and the work will take several hours to finish. We require that you please take any items you wish to borrow to one of the front desks instead. To make sure that you are not kept waiting, we will have additional assistants on duty that evening. If you have questions or need help, please visit our customer service counter. Thank you.
